positions.title: Snr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Consolidated two rails frontends into one rails app
• Mentored interns during their summer project
• Led a project to update the UI for our rails frontend
• Led a project to transition our call center representatives from a legacy rails app portal to an emberjs app
• Reduced the overhead needed to add new email mailers by refactoring the code to make it more readable and flexible
• Refactored the leads service to reduce the amount of time needed to add a new lead provider from two to three weeks down to a week

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented a feature to allow customers to refinance their loans within seconds 
  • Wrote a new suite of cucumber and rspec examples to fully test our implementation
Chicago, IL
• Worked with my teammates to come up with a new process for our software development life cycle 
* Pivotal story creation, code reviews, quality assurance, coordination with business owners for acceptance criteria, having a release captain for deployments and post-release testing
• Integrated our Frontend rails app with an in-house built Content Management System to enable our marketing team to easily create landing
  * The CMS is integrated with the help of a Rails Engine called Landable, which has been open sourced
• Redesigned and refactored our call center representative portal
• Upgraded our rails frontend from rails 3 to rails 4
